newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine's Kuchma to visit Poland.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine's Kuchma to visit Poland.

text.p: Ukrainian President Leonid Kuchma will visit Poland on Thursday to boost political ties and trade relations, the presidential press office said on Tuesday.
Kuchma will sign a memorandum on free trade with Polish President Aleksander Kwasniewski and also will meet Prime Minister Wlodzimierz Cimoszewicz.

Ukraine considers Poland a "strategic partner" and, unlike neighbours Russia and Belarus, backs Poland's bid for NATO membership. Poland, the Czech Republic and Hungary are the most likely early candidates to join the Western security alliance.
